faq.question: Can Birdcast record training videos for companies?
faq.answer: Yes. Birdcast can support employee training, onboarding, internal lessons, educational content and process explainers.

faq.question: Can several modules be recorded together?
faq.answer: Yes. Multiple short lessons or training sections can be recorded during one planned session if the outline is ready.

faq.question: Is a teleprompter useful for training content?
faq.answer: Yes. A teleprompter can help when the content is scripted, detailed or needs consistent delivery across multiple modules.

faq.question: Can training videos be used internally?
faq.answer: Yes. Training content can be prepared for internal platforms, Google Drive delivery or other company channels.

faq.question: What should we send before the shoot?
faq.answer: Send the training outline, number of modules, target audience, speaker details and whether the content needs slides or scripted delivery.
